description: Fetch a stored verdict by receipt id to re-read it. No key; verify_receipt checks it is genuine. The receipt is content-hashed, reproducible from the open-source core it names, and signed with Ed25519 by a key published at https://canlicapital.com/.well-known/canli-receipt-keys.json.

id.description: Receipt id from a validation result.

name: get_receipt

outputSchema.description: data is the stored receipt: validator, input, output, their hashes, source hashes and signature.

title: Get a receipt
